name: Book of Dead

features.name: Expanding symbol
features.description: Before free spins a random symbol is chosen; during the bonus it expands to fill reels and pays on any position.

features.name: Gamble
features.description: Optional double-or-nothing card gamble on wins (removed in some markets).

review:
Rich Wilde and the template for every modern book slot. Ten free spins with one random expanding symbol – that's the whole bonus, and that simplicity is the point. Everything depends on which symbol gets picked.

A high-paying expanding symbol can fill the screen; a low one usually gives a modest bonus. There's a gamble after wins too. High volatility, 5,000x max. Note that casinos can run lots of different RTP versions – the info screen tells you which.
cons: Operators may run RTPs far below 96.21%
